works.title: Spiritual Awakening and Solitary Realizer Journey
works.description: Personal documentation of a spiritual awakening experience beginning October 30, 2023, after 500 hours of sensory deprivation meditation practice. The user describes this as a Vajra/Satori realization in Tibetan Buddhist terms, marked by ongoing physical manifestations (psoriasis, lung purging, nervous system integration) and integration of consciousness into daily practices, particularly golf. The work traces the physiological and psychological processing of the awakening, including recovery from hospitalization and emotional reckoning with the barriers faced during emergence as a solitary realizer.
works.quote: On October 30th, 2023, after many years of meditation and training—including approximately 500 hours in sensory deprivation tanks—and living my life in a constant state of meditation without relaxing my practice, I experienced something significant.

works.title: Divine Workshop Creation Parable
works.description: A philosophical narrative parable told as dialogue between God and God's child, set in a timeless cosmic workshop where universes are created. The story explores how imperfection—introduced when the child removes a perfection-force—paradoxically becomes the substrate for all existence, stars, planets, and galaxies. The work develops theological themes about creativity, limitation, and the nature of being, presented through storytelling rather than philosophical exposition.
works.quote: Those tiny bits that weren't quite perfect? Those little imperfections? That's what became everything. All the stars. All the planets. Every galaxy spinning through space. Everything you see when you look up at the night sky—it all came from that one tiny flaw.
